title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I have to admit you've done quite well. We should have more than enough to repay that younger student.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I didn't realize you had such talent lurking within you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You have a rarely seen focus, or perhaps zeal. I may have to reconsider my estimation of you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No… I should save my praise for your work as a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Of course, I expect just as much zeal from you in that capacity.
